events.title: Innovations & Strategic Buyouts Aid Rollins Amid Integration Risk
events.body: ROL's growth rides on tech-driven efficiency and steady acquisitions. Its rising costs, integration risks and liquidity concerns could weigh on margins.

events.title: Broadridge Q3 Earnings & Revenues Beat Estimates, Increase Y/Y
events.body: BR posts Q3 earnings and revenue beat, driven by solid recurring revenue growth. The company raises its full-year EPS outlook.

events.title: Trane Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates on Strong Bookings, Backlog
events.body: TT tops Q1 estimates as bookings jumped 24% and backlog hit a record $10.7B, prompting a higher 2026 outlook.
